newsitem.title: HONG KONG: National Elec to buy HK$178 mln office.
newsitem.headline: National Elec to buy HK$178 mln office.

text.p: National Electronics Holdings Ltd said on Thursday it will buy the 36th floor, covering an area of 10,800 sq ft, of Far East Finance Centre in Hong Kong's Admiralty district for HK$178.2 million or HK$16,500 per sq ft.
The watch parts and telecommunication equipment manufacturer said a total HK$26.73 million has been paid and the balance of HK$151.47 million will be paid on completion of the deal on March 27, 1997.

The company, whose subsidiaries engage in property development and investment, said the office property would be retained for rental income and the purchase would be funded by internal resources and bank borrowings.
"This will not have any material adverse effect on the company's cash flow or gearing position," it said.
Earlier this week, the company had agreed to buy the 45th floor of Far East Finance Centre for HK$180 million and sell of the 30th floor of the same building for HK$181.44 million.
